package.name: nav2_depth_obstacle_layer
package.description: Nav2 costmap layer that projects depth image points as obstacles, with optional human detection masking. Also provides BehaviorTree nodes for human-aware navigation. Costmap Layer: - Projects depth image points as LETHAL_OBSTACLE - Filters by height above ground - Masks out detected humans (requires zed_msgs) BT Nodes: - HumanBlockingPath: Condition - checks if human blocks path - WaitUntilHumanClears: Action - stops robot, calls /speak service
